steps.title: Hold a key and drag
steps.text: Select files in File Explorer or on the desktop and drag them with Ctrl held down, or any modifier key you choose.

steps.title: Drop on a format
steps.text: A donut of the formats that fit those files opens at your cursor. Move onto one and let go.

steps.title: Done, next to the original
steps.text: A progress ring counts up and the new files appear beside the originals. Prefer menus? Right-click and choose Convert with Filee.

features.title: Everything a converter should do. Nothing it shouldn't.

items.title: A donut at your cursor
items.text: No app window in the way: the formats appear where you already are. A modifier key, mouse button, hold gesture or keyboard shortcut opens it.

items.title: {formatCount} formats, one gesture
items.text: Images, PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HWP, e-books, video, audio, archives, CAD drawings and fonts. Filee plans the route between formats automatically.

items.title: No Office needed
items.text: Word, Excel and PowerPoint files convert without Microsoft Office or LibreOffice, and HWP without Hancom Office. Filee never uses programs installed on your PC.

items.title: Batch conversion
items.text: Drop 1 file or 100. They're converted in parallel, a failure never stops the rest, and presets can merge everything into one PDF or one ZIP.

items.title: 100% on your PC
items.text: Nothing is uploaded. Filee works offline, so private documents, photos and recordings never leave your computer.

items.title: Right where you work
items.text: The drag gesture, Convert with Filee at the top of the Windows 11 right-click menu, Send To, a keyboard shortcut or the drop zone in the main window.

items.title: Presets per file type
items.text: Quality, resizing, DPI, grayscale, metadata, TIFF compression, ICO sizes, PDF merge, split and page ranges, 720p video, MP3 bitrate, output folder and file names.

items.title: Small installer, engines on demand
items.text: Large engines are optional downloads inside the app: {engineNames}. Filee shows their versions, download speed and time left.

items.title: Free and open source
items.text: MIT licensed, no ads, no account. In English, Korean and Simplified Chinese, with automatic updates that list the changes and contributors.

formats.title: {formatTotal} formats in {categoryCount} categories
formats.lead: Filee finds the best route between formats automatically, for example HWPX → PDF → PNG, and uses the engine that does each step best.
formats.catalog: See all {formatTotal} formats in the catalog

hwp.title: HWP and HWPX without Hancom Office
hwp.text: Filee reads and writes Korean Hangul documents itself, so there is no Hancom license to buy and no approval dialog to click through.
hwp.quality: DOCX → HWPX keeps page setup, headers and footers, tables with merged cells, text boxes and pictures

convert.howTitle: How to convert {from} to {to} on Windows

steps.title: Select your {from} files
steps.text: In File Explorer or on the desktop, select one {from} file or as many as you like.

steps.title: Hold Ctrl and drag
steps.text: Hold Ctrl (or the key you set in Filee) and drag the files. A donut of formats opens at the cursor. Prefer menus? Right-click and choose Convert with Filee.

steps.title: Drop on {to}
steps.text: Release the files over {to}. A progress ring counts up, and each {to} file is saved next to its original.
